additions.text: Reports mild tingling in the fingers, possibly related to swelling; sensation in fingers preserved.
additions.why: Paresthesia after a distal radius fracture may signal median nerve compromise and needs to be documented and monitored.

evidence.quote: maybe a little bit of tingling
i can feel it my fingers still

additions.text: Painful radial and ulnar deviation; unable to make a tight fist.
additions.why: Documents functional limitation and baseline range of motion before surgery and PT.

evidence.quote: wrist abduction adduction positive for pain on movement
i ca n't do it really tight

additions.text: Vitals: BP 140/70 (likely pain-related), HR 80, T 97.2, RR 20.
additions.why: Vital signs, including the elevated blood pressure, are part of the pre-operative record.

evidence.quote: a hundred and forty over over seventy
your respiratory rate is pretty normal at like twenty

additions.text: General exam: no adenopathy or thyromegaly, no murmur, lungs clear bilaterally, palpable pulses, no lower extremity edema.
additions.why: Normal cardiopulmonary and vascular findings support surgical clearance.

evidence.quote: i do n't appreciate any murmur no rub no gallop
you have palpable pulses no lower edema

additions.text: Planned vacation in 1 month for 2 weeks; may need to postpone depending on PT, to be reassessed at the 1-month follow-up.
additions.why: Travel may interfere with post-operative PT and follow-up, and the counseling given should be recorded.

evidence.quote: i'm going a vacation in a month
you might have to postpone it

follow_up_questions.question: Can you feel me touching each fingertip, and is the numbness or tingling getting worse? Let me check your capillary refill and radial pulse.
follow_up_questions.why: Tingling with marked swelling after a Colles fracture requires a documented neurovascular exam to rule out median nerve injury or compartment syndrome.

follow_up_questions.question: When you fell on the stairs, did you hit your head, lose consciousness, or hurt anything else like your elbow, shoulder or hip?
follow_up_questions.why: A fall down stairs can cause additional injuries that were not assessed.

follow_up_questions.question: Do you have any allergies, take any other medications such as blood thinners or antidepressants, or have kidney, stomach or seizure problems?
follow_up_questions.why: Needed before prescribing tramadol, continuing ibuprofen and planning surgery and anesthesia.

follow_up_questions.question: Which is your dominant hand, and what kind of work do you do?
follow_up_questions.why: Hand dominance and occupation affect surgical planning, return to work and PT goals.
